pli-tv-kd15:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nahāyamānā rukkhe kāyaṃ ugghaṃsenti ūrum pi bāham pi uram pi piṭṭhim pi.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.4: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā nahāyamānā rukkhe kāyaṃ ugghaṃsessanti . . . piṭṭhim pi seyyathāpi mallamuṭṭhikā gāmapoddavā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū . . . piṭṭhim pīti.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.12: kathañ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā nahāyamānā rukkhe kāyaṃ ugghaṃsessanti . . . piṭṭhim pi.
pli-tv-kd15:1.1.16: na bhikkhave nahāyamānena bhikkhunā rukkhe kāyo ugghaṃsetabbo.

pli-tv-kd15:1.2.11: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nahāyamānā kuḍḍe kāyaṃ ugghaṃsenti . . .
pli-tv-kd15:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aṭṭāne nahāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:1.3.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:1.3.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:1.3.11: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū gandhabbahatthakena nahāyanti . . .
pli-tv-kd15:1.3.18: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kuruvindakasuttiyā nahāyanti . . .
pli-tv-kd15:1.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vigayha parikammaṃ kārāpenti . . .
pli-tv-kd15:1.4.7: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū mallakena nahāyanti . . .
pli-tv-kd15:1.4.13: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno kacchurogābādho hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:1.4.14: tassa vinā mallakā na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:1.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu jarādubbalo nahāyamāno na sakkoti attano kāyaṃ ugghaṃsetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:1.5.4: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū piṭṭhiparikammaṃ kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vallikaṃ dhārenti,
pli-tv-kd15:2.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dīghe kese dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave dumāsikaṃ vā duvaṅgulaṃ vā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd15:2.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kocchena kese osaṇhenti,
pli-tv-kd15:2.3.2: phaṇakena kese osaṇhenti, hatthaphaṇakena kese osaṇhenti, sitthatelakena kese osaṇhenti, udakatelakena kese osaṇhenti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ādāse pi udakapatte pi mukhanimittaṃ olokenti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.4.5: na bhikkhave ādāse vā udakapatte vā mukhanimittaṃ oloketabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:2.4.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno mukhe vaṇo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.4.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave ābādhapaccayā ādāse vā udakapatte vā mukhanimittaṃ oloketun ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd15:2.5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū mukhaṃ ālimpanti,
pli-tv-kd15:2.5.2: mukhaṃ ummaddenti, mukhaṃ cuṇṇenti, manosilikāya mukhaṃ lañchenti, aṅgarāgaṃ karonti, mukharāgaṃ karonti, aṅgarāgamukharāgaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.5.7: na mukhaṃ ummadditabbaṃ, na mukhaṃ cuṇṇetabbaṃ, na manosilikāya mukhaṃ lañchetabbaṃ, na aṅgarāgo kātabbo, na mukharāgo kātabbo, na aṅgarāgamukharāgo kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:2.5.9: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno cakkhurogābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.5.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave ābādhapaccayā mukhaṃ ālimpitun ti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd15:2.6.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahe giraggasamajjo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:2.6.4: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā naccam pi gītam pi vāditam pi dassanāya āgacchissanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhogino 'ti .
pli-tv-kd15:2.6.6: na bhikkhave naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā vāditaṃ vā dassanāya gantabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ gāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.3: yath' eva mayaṃ gāyāma evam ev' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ gāyantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesam manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.5: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.6: kathañ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ gāyissantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.11: pañc' ime bhikkhave ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ gāyantassa:
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.12: attanāpi tasmiṃ sare sārajjati, pare pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjanti, gahapatikāpi ujjhāyanti, sarakuttiṃ pi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa bhaṅgo hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.13: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā āyatakena gītassarena dhammaṃ gāyantassa.
pli-tv-kd15:3.1.14: na bhikkhave āyatakena gītassarena dhammo gāyitabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:3.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sarabhaññe kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bāhiralomiṃ uṇṇiṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa ārāme ambā phalitā honti
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.2: raññā ca Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena anuññātaṃ hoti
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.4: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū taruṇañ ñeva ambaṃ pātāpetvā paribhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.5: rañño ca Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa ambena attho hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.6: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro manusse āṇāpesi:
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.7: gacchatha bhaṇe ārāmaṃ gantvā ambaṃ āharathā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.8: evaṃ devā 'ti kho te manussā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa paṭissutvā ārāmaṃ gantvā ārāmapāle etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.9: devassa bhaṇe ambena attho, ambaṃ dethā 'ti. n' atth'
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.11: taruṇaṃ yeva ambaṃ pātāpetvā bhikkhū paribhuñjiṃsū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.12: atha kho te manussā rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.13: suparibhuttaṃ bhaṇe ayyehi ambaṃ, api ca bhagavatā mattā vaṇṇitā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.15: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā rañño ambaṃ paribhuñjissantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.16: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:5.1.17: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam athaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:5.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghabhattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.2.6: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghabhattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.2.7: te na pariyāpuṇiṃsu pesikaṃ kātuṃ, bhattagge sakaleh' eva ambehi caranti.
pli-tv-kd15:5.2.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcahi samaṇakappehi phalaṃ paribhuñjituṃ
pli-tv-kd15:5.2.11: aggiparicitaṃ satthaparicitaṃ nakhaparicitaṃ abījaṃ nivattabījañ ñeva pañcamaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:5.2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi pañcahi samaṇakappehi phalaṃ paribhuñjitun ti. ||2||5||
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṃkato hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.3: na ha nūna so bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.4: sace hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya na hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.6: Virūpakkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, Erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, Chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, Kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.7: na ha nūna so bhikkhave bhikkhu imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.8: sace hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya na hi so bhikkhave bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.33: katā me rakkhā katā me parittā,
pli-tv-kd15:6.1.36: namo sattannaṃ sammāsambuddhānan ti. anujānāmi bhikkhave lohitaṃ mocetun ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd15:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu anabhiratiyā pīḷito attano aṅgajātaṃ chindi.
pli-tv-kd15:7.1.3: aññamhi so bhikkhave moghapuriso chetabbamhi aññaṃ chindi.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa mahagghassa candanasārassa candanagaṇṭhī uppannā hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.2: atha kho Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.4: lekhañ ca me paribhogaṃ bhavissati pattañ ca dānaṃ dassāmīti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.5: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi tāya candanagaṇṭhiyā pattaṃ likhāpetvā sikkāya pakkhipitvā veḷagge ālaggetvā veḷuparamparāya bandhitvā evam āha:
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.6: yo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā arahā c' eva iddhimā ca dinnaṃ yeva pattaṃ oharatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.7: atha kho Pūraṇo Kassapo yena Rājagahako seṭṭhi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Rājagahakaṃ seṭṭhiṃ etad avoca: ahaṃ
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.8: hi gahapati arahā c' eva iddhimā ca, dehi me pattan ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.9: sace bhante āyasmā arahā c' eva iddhimā ca, dinnaṃ yeva pattaṃ oharatū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.17: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca Piṇḍolabhāradvājo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.18: atha kho āyasmā Piṇḍolabhāradvājo āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.19: āyasmā kho Mahāmoggallāno arahā c' eva iddhimā ca,
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.22: āyasmā kho Piṇḍolabhāradvājo arahā c' eva iddhimā ca,
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.25: atha kho āyasmā Piṇḍolabhāradvājo vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā taṃ pattaṃ gahetvā tikkhattuṃ Rājagahaṃ anupariyāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.26: tena kho pana samayena Rājagahako seṭṭhi saputtadāro sake nivesane ṭhito hoti pañjaliko namassamāno
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.27: idh' eva bhante ayyo Bhāradvājo amhākaṃ nivesane patiṭṭhātū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.28: atha kho āyasmā Piṇḍolabhāradvājo Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa nivesane patiṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.29: atha kho Rājagahako seṭṭhi āyasmato Piṇḍolabhāradvājassa hatthato pattaṃ gahetvā mahagghassa khādaniyassa pūretvā āyasmato Piṇḍolabhāradvājassa pādāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:8.1.30: atha kho āyasmā Piṇḍolabhāradvājo taṃ pattaṃ gahetvā ārāmaṃ agamāsi. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.2: ayyena kira Piṇḍolabhāradvājena Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa patto ohārito 'ti,
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.3: te ca manussā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā āyasmantaṃ Piṇḍolabhāradvājaṃ piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubandhiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.6: kiṃ nu kho so Ānanda uccāsaddo mahāsaddo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.7: āyasmatā bhante Piṇḍolabhāradvājena Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa patto ohārito,
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.11: so eso bhante bhagavā uccāsaddo mahāsaddo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Piṇḍolabhāradvājaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.13: saccaṃ kira tayā Bhāradvāja Rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa patto ohārito 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.17: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ Bhāradvāja chavassa dārupattassa kāraṇā gihīnaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassessasi.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.18: seyyathāpi Bhāradvāja mātugāmo chavassa māsakarūpassa kāraṇā kopīnaṃ dasseti
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.19: evam eva kho tayā Bhāradvāja chavassa dārupattassa kāraṇā gihīnaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassitaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.23: na bhikkhave gihīnaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:8.2.25: bhindath' etaṃ bhikkhave dārupattaṃ, sakalikaṃ-sakalikaṃ katvā bhikkhūnaṃ añjanupapisanaṃ detha.
pli-tv-kd15:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace patte dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.1: tena kho pana samayena pattamūlaṃ ghaṃsīyati.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.18: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū citrāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhārenti rūpakokiṇṇāni bhatikammakatāni,
pli-tv-kd15:9.2.23: na bhikkhave citrāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhāretabbāni rūpakokiṇṇāni bhatikammakatāni.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saudakaṃ pattaṃ paṭisāmenti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave otāpetvā pattaṃ paṭisāmetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.7: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saudakaṃ pattaṃ otāpenti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave vodakaṃ katvā otāpetvā pattaṃ paṭisāmetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū uṇhe pattaṃ nidahanti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.3.18: anujānāmi bhikkhave muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetvā pattaṃ paṭisāmetun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā pattā ajjhokāse anādhārā nikkhittā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.5: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū miḍhante pattaṃ nikkhipanti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū paribhaṇḍante pattaṃ nikkhipanti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.4.15: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chamāya pattaṃ nikkujjanti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhittikhīle pi nāgadantake pi pattaṃ laggenti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.6: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū mañce pattaṃ nikkhipanti, satisammosā nisīdantā ottharitvā pattaṃ bhindanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū pīṭhe pattaṃ nikkhipanti, satisammosā nisīdantā ottharitvā pattaṃ bhindanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.14: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū aṅke pattaṃ nikkhipanti. satisammosā vuṭṭhahanti,
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.19: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chatte pattaṃ nikkhipanti.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.20: vātamaṇḍalikāya chattaṃ ukkhipīyati, paripatitvā patto bhijjati.
pli-tv-kd15:9.5.24: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū pattahatthā kavāṭaṃ paṇāmenti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tumbakaṭāhe piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.1.7: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ghaṭikaṭāhe piṇḍāya caranti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sabbapaṃsukūliko hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:10.2.3: aññatarā itthi passitvā bhītā vissaram akāsi:
pli-tv-kd15:10.2.4: abbhuṃ me, pisāco vata man ti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.2.6: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā chavasīsassa pattaṃ dhāressanti seyyathāpi pisācillikā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū calakāni pi aṭṭhikāni pi ucchiṭṭhodakam pi pattena nīharanti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.3.3: yasmiṃ yev' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā bhuñjanti so 'va nesaṃ paṭiggaho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:10.3.5: na bhikkhave calakāni vā aṭṭhikāni vā ucchiṭṭhodakaṃ vā pattena nīharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū hatthena vipāṭetvā cīvaraṃ sibbenti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.5: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa daṇḍasatthakaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.8: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace satthakadaṇḍe dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimayan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:11.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kukkuṭapattena pi veḷupesikāya pi cīvaraṃ sibbenti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū tattha-tattha khīlaṃ nikhanitvā sambandhitvā cīvaraṃ sibbenti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave kaṭhinaṃ kaṭhinarajjuṃ tattha-tattha obandhitvā cīvaraṃ sibbetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave anuvātaṃ paribhaṇḍaṃ āropetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.3.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave daṇḍakaṭhinaṃ pidalakaṃ salākaṃ vinandhanarajjuṃ vinandhanasuttakaṃ vinandhitvā cīvaraṃ sibbetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū adhotehi pādehi kaṭhinaṃ akkamanti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.4: na bhikkhave adhotehi pādehi kaṭhinaṃ akkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.6: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū allehi pādehi kaṭhinaṃ akkamanti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.9: na bhikkhave allehi pādehi kaṭhinaṃ akkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.4.11: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū saupāhanā kaṭhinaṃ akkamanti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvaraṃ sibbentā aṅguliyā paṭigaṇhanti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace paṭiggahe dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:11.5.13: tena kho pana samayena sūciyo pi satthakāpi paṭiggahāpi nassanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū abbhokāse cīvaraṃ sibbentā sītena pi uṇhena pi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.6.17: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭṭhikaṃ cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvararajjun ti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvaraṃ sibbetvā tatth' eva kaṭhinaṃ ujjhitvā pakkamanti, undurehi pi upacikāhi pi khajjati.
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave goghaṃsikāya kaṭhinaṃ saṃharitun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.8: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kuḍḍe pi thambhe pi kaṭhinaṃ ussāpetvā pakkamanti,
pli-tv-kd15:11.7.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhittikhīle vā nāgadante vā laggetun ti. ||7||11||
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sūcikam pi satthakam pi bhesajjam pi pattena ādāya gacchanti.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.7: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu upāhanāyo kāyabandhane bandhitvā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.8: aññataro upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādento upāhanāyo sīsena ghaṭṭesi,
pli-tv-kd15:12.1.10: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena antarā magge udakaṃ akappiyaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:13.1.7: colakaṃ na ppahoti. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū Kosalesu janapadesu addhānamaggapaṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.3: dutiyo bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.7: atha kho so bhikkhu pipāsāya pīḷito upanandhaṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.8: dehi me āvuso parissāvanaṃ, pāniyaṃ pivissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.10: so bhikkhu pipāsāya pīḷito kālam akāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.11: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.12: kim pana tvaṃ āvuso parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na adāsīti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.15: kathañ hi nāma bhikkhu parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na dassatīti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.16: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.17: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.18: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na adāsīti.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.22: kathañ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa parissāvanaṃ yāciyamāno na dassasi.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.23: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.26: na bhikkhave addhānamaggapaṭipannena bhikkhunā parissāvanaṃ yāciyamānena na dātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.28: na ca bhikkhave aparissāvanakena addhānamaggo paṭipajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:13.2.30: sace na hoti parissāvanaṃ vā dhammakarako vā, saṃghāṭikaṇṇo pi adhiṭṭhātabbo
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.1: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Vesālī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.3: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū navakammaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd15:13.3.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū makasehi ubbāḷhā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Vesāliyaṃ paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭī adhiṭṭhitā hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.2: bhikkhū paṇītāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā abhisannakāyā honti bahvābādhā.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.3: atha kho Jīvako Komārabhacco Vesāliṃ agamāsi kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.4: addasā kho Jīvako Komārabhacco bhikkhū abhisannakāye bahvābādhe,
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.5: disvāna yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jīvako Komārabhacco bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.8: sādhu bhante bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ caṅkamañ ca jantāgharañ ca anujānātu,
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.10: atha kho bhagavā Jīvakaṃ Komārabhaccaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.11: atha kho Jīvako Komārabhacco bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito . . . sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:14.1.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave caṅkamañ ca jantāgharañ cā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū visame caṅkame caṅkamanti,
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.16: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū caṅkame caṅkamantā paripatanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.2.19: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse caṅkamantā sītena pi uṇhena pi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṃghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakaṃ aggalavaṭṭiṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ tālacchiddaṃ āviñchanacchiddaṃ āviñchanarajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.13: jantāgharassa kuḍḍapādo jīrati. bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.17: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū khuddake jantāghare majjhe aggiṭṭhānaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.20: anujānāmi bhikkhave khuddake jantāghare ekamantaṃ aggiṭṭhānaṃ kātuṃ, mahallake majjhe 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.32: anujānāmi bhikkhave ogumphetvā ullittāvalittaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.40: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū jantāghare chamāya nisīdanti gattāni kaṇḍuvanti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.3.43: tena kho pana samayena jantāgharaṃ aparikkhittaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.4.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṃghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakaṃ aggalavaṭṭiṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ tālacchiddaṃ āviñchanacchiddaṃ āviñchanarajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:14.4.17: setavaṇṇaṃ kāḷavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭṭhikan ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd15:15.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū naggā naggaṃ abhivādenti
pli-tv-kd15:15.1.2: naggā naggaṃ abhivādāpenti naggā naggassa parikammaṃ karonti naggā naggassa parikammaṃ kārāpenti naggā naggassa denti naggā paṭigaṇhanti naggā khādanti naggā bhuñjanti naggā sāyanti naggā pivanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū jantāghare chamāya cīvaraṃ nikkhipanti,
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū jantāghare pi udake pi parikammaṃ kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.5.1: tena kho pana samayena jantāghare udakaṃ na hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.17: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū vallikāya pi kāyabandhanena pi udakaṃ vāhanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.21: anujānāmi bhikkhave tulaṃ karakaṭakaṃ cakkavaṭṭakan ti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.25: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse udakaṃ vāhantā sītena pi uṇhena pi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:16.2.31: udakapāno apāruto hoti, tiṇacuṇṇehi pi paṃsukehi pi okirīyati.
pli-tv-kd15:17.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ārāme tahaṃ-tahaṃ nahāyanti,
pli-tv-kd15:17.1.14: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ gattāni sītikatāni honti.
pli-tv-kd15:17.1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave udakapuñchaniṃ colakena pi paccuddharitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:17.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako saṃghassa atthāya pokkharaṇiṃ kāretukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:17.2.14: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu saṃghassa atthāya nillekhaṃ jantāgharaṃ kattukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū catumāsaṃ nisīdanena vippavasanti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pupphābhikiṇṇesu sayanesu sayanti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.11: tena kho pana samayena manussā gandham pi mālam pi ādāya ārāmaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-kd15:18.1.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave gandhaṃ gahetvā kavāṭe pañcaṅgulikaṃ dātuṃ, pupphaṃ gahetvā vihāre ekamantaṃ nikkhipitun ti. ||18||
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa namatakaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.5: namatakaṃ adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ nu kho udāhu vikappetabban ti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.6: na bhikkhave namatakaṃ adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ na vikappetabban ti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.7: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū āsittakūpadhāne bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.13: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:19.1.14: so bhuñjamāno na sakkoti hatthena pattaṃ sandhāretuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:19.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ekabhājane pi bhuñjanti
pli-tv-kd15:19.2.2: ekathālake pi pivanti ekamañce pi tuvaṭṭenti ekattharaṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti ekapāvuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti ekattharaṇapāvuraṇāpi tuvaṭṭenti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Vaḍḍho Licchavi Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sahāyo hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.2: atha kho Vaḍḍho Licchavi yena Mettiyabhummajakā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.5: dutiyam pi kho . . . tatiyam pi kho Vaḍḍho Licchavi Mettiyabhummajake bhikkhū etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.11: ky āhaṃ ayyānaṃ aparajjhāmi, kissa maṃ ayyā nālapantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.12: tathā hi pana tvaṃ āvuso Vaḍḍha amhe Dabbena Mallaputtena viheṭhiyamāne ajjhupekkhasīti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.14: sace kho tvaṃ āvuso Vaḍḍha iccheyyāsi ajj' eva bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ nāsāpeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.15: ky āhaṃ ayyā karomi, kiṃ mayā sakkā kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.16: ehi tvaṃ āvuso Vaḍḍha yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.17: idaṃ bhante na channaṃ na paṭirūpaṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.18: yāyaṃ bhante disā abhayā anītikā anupaddavā sāyaṃ disā sabhayā saītikā saupaddavā,
pli-tv-kd15:20.1.21: ayyena me Dabbena Mallaputtena pajāpatī dūsitā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.1: evaṃ ayyā 'ti kho Vaḍḍho Licchavi Mettiyabhummajakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Vaḍḍho Licchavi bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.9: sarasi tvaṃ Dabba evarūpaṃ kattā yathāyaṃ Vaḍḍho āhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.12: tatiyam pi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.15: na kho Dabba Dabbā evaṃ nibbeṭhenti,
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.16: sace tayā kataṃ katan ti vadehi,
pli-tv-kd15:20.2.18: yato 'haṃ bhante jāto nābhijānāmi supinantena pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitā pag eva jāgaro 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattaṃ nikkujjatu asambhogaṃ saṃghena karotu.
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa patto nikkujjitabbo:
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.4: bhikkhūnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati, bhikkhūnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati, bhikkhūnaṃ avāsāya parisakkati, bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati, bhikkhū bhikkhūhi bhedeti, buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṃghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd15:20.3.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa pattaṃ nikkujjituṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.4: Vaḍḍho Licchavi āyasmantaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃseti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattaṃ nikkujjeyya asambhogaṃ saṃghena kareyya.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.9: saṃgho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattaṃ nikkujjati asambhogaṃ saṃghena karoti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.10: yassāyasmato khamati Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattassa nikkujjanā asambhogaṃ saṃghena karaṇaṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd15:20.4.12: nikkujjito saṃghena Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa patto asambhogo saṃghena.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Vaḍḍhaṃ Licchaviṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.2: saṃghena te āvuso Vaḍḍha patto nikkujjito
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.5: saṃghena kira me patto nikkujjito asambhogo 'mhi kira saṃghenā 'ti
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.7: atha kho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā Vaḍḍhaṃ Licchaviṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.8: alaṃ āvuso Vaḍḍha mā soci mā paridevi,
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.10: atha kho Vaḍḍho Licchavi saputtadāro samittāmacco sañātisālohito allavattho allakeso yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.11: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ yo 'haṃ ayyaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsesiṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.12: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.13: taggha tvaṃ āvuso Vaḍḍha accayo accagamā yathā bālaṃ yathā mūḷhaṃ yathā akusalaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ Dabbaṃ Mallaputtaṃ amūlikāya sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.14: yato ca kho tvaṃ āvuso Vaḍḍha accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tan te mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma,
pli-tv-kd15:20.5.15: vuḍḍhi h' esā āvuso Vaḍḍha ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd15:20.6.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattaṃ ukkujjatu sambhogaṃ saṃghena karotu.
pli-tv-kd15:20.6.3: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa patto ukkujjitabbo:
pli-tv-kd15:20.6.4: na bhikkhūnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati, na bhikkhūnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati, na bhikkhūnaṃ avāsāya parisakkati, na bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati, na bhikkhū bhikkhūhi bhedeti, na buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, na dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, na saṃghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd15:20.6.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa pattaṃ ukkujjituṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.2: tena bhikkhave Vaḍḍhena Licchavinā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.3: saṃghena me bhante patto nikkujjito asambhogo 'mhi saṃghena,
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.4: so 'haṃ bhante sammāvattāmi lomaṃ pātemi netthāraṃ vattāmi saṃghaṃ pattukkujjanaṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.9: saṃghena Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa patto nikkujjito asambhogo saṃghena,
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.11: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattaṃ ukkujjeyya sambhogaṃ saṃghena kareyya.
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.16: saṃgho Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattaṃ ukkujjati sambhogaṃ saṃghena karoti.
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.17: yassāyasmato khamati Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa pattassa ukkujjanā sambhogaṃ saṃghena karaṇaṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd15:20.7.19: ukkujjito saṃghena Vaḍḍhassa Licchavissa patto sambhogo saṃghena.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bhaggā tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.2: anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Bhaggā tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Bodhissa rājakumārassa Kokanado nāma pāsādo acirakārito hoti anajjhāvuttho samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.5: atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro Sañjikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.6: ehi tvaṃ samma Sañjikāputta yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.7: appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.8: Bodhi bhante rājakumāro bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati: appābādhaṃ . . . phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati evaṃ
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.10: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā Bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.11: evaṃ bho 'ti kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.12: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.13: Bodhi kho rājakumāro bhoto Gotamassa pāde . . .
pli-tv-kd15:21.1.15: adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ Gotamo Bodhissa . . . bhikkhusaṃghenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.1: atha kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bodhi rājakumāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.2: avocumha kho mayaṃ bhoto vacanena taṃ bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.7: atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā Kokanadañ ca pāsādaṃ odātehi dussehi santharāpetvā yāva pacchimā sopānakaliṅgarā Sañjikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.8: ehi tvaṃ samma Sañjikāputta yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocehi
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.10: evaṃ bho 'ti kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.11: kālo bho Gotama niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.12: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Bodhissa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.13: tena kho pana samayena Bodhi rājakumāro bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ āgamayamāno.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.14: addasā kho Bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.15: disvāna tato paccuggantvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā purakkhatvā yena Kokanado pāsādo ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.16: atha kho bhagavā pacchimaṃ sopānakaliṅgaraṃ nissāya aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.17: atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.18: akkamatu bhante bhagavā dussāni akkamatu sugato dussāni yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.21: tatiyam pi kho Bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.23: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ apalokesi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.24: atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.2.26: na bhagavā celapattikaṃ akkamissati, pacchimaṃ janataṃ tathāgato anukampatīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.1: atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro dussāni saṃharāpetvā upari Kokanade āsanaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.2: atha kho bhagavā Kokanadaṃ pāsādaṃ abhirūhitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.3: atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā . . . sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:21.3.5: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā itthi apagatagabbhā bhikkhū nimantetvā dussaṃ paññāpetvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.6: atha kho sā itthi ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.7: kathañ hi nāma ayyā maṅgalatthāya yāciyamānā celapattikaṃ na akkamissantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassā itthiyā ujjhāyantiyā khīyantiyā vipācentiyā.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave gihīnaṃ maṅgalatthāya yāciyamānena celapattikaṃ akkamitun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:21.4.12: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dhotapādakaṃ akkamituṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Bhaggesu yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.2: anupubbena cārikañ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.4: atha kho Visākhā Migāramātā ghaṭakañ ca katakañ ca sammajjaniñ ca ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Visākhā Migāramātā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.6: paṭigaṇhātu me bhante bhagavā ghaṭakañ ca katakañ ca sammajjaniñ ca yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.7: paṭiggahesi bhagavā ghaṭakañ ca sammajjaniñ ca,
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.9: atha kho bhagavā Visākhaṃ Migāramātaraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.10: atha kho Visākhā Migāramātā bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā . . . sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.11: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:22.1.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave ghaṭakañ ca sammajjaniñ ca.
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.1: atha kho Visākhā Migāramātā vidhūpanañ ca tālavaṇṭañ ca ādāya yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Visākhā Migāramātā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.3: paṭigaṇhātu me bhante bhagavā vidhūpanañ ca tālavaṇṭañ ca yaṃ mam' assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.4: paṭiggahesi bhagavā vidhūpanañ ca tālavaṇṭañ ca.
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.5: atha kho bhagavā Visākhaṃ Migāramātaraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi . . . sampahaṃsesi --la--
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:22.2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave vidhūpanañ ca tālavaṇṭañ cā 'ti. ||2||22||
pli-tv-kd15:23.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa makasavījanī uppannā hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa chattaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattaṃ paggahetvā āhiṇḍanti.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.5: tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako sambahulehi ājīvakasāvakehi saddhiṃ uyyānaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.6: addasāsuṃ kho te ājīvakasāvakā chabbaggiye bhikkhū dūrato 'va chattapaggahite āgacchante,
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.8: ete kho ayyo tumhākaṃ bhaddantā chattapaggahitā āgacchanti seyyathāpi gaṇakamahāmattā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.11: atha kho so upāsako upagate sañjānitvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā chattapaggahitā āhiṇḍissantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa upāsakassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd15:23.2.14: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:23.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:23.3.2: tassa vinā chattena na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:23.4.2: gilānass' eva bhagavatā chattaṃ anuññātaṃ no agilānassā 'ti
pli-tv-kd15:23.4.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena pi agilānena pi ārāme ārāmūpacāre chattaṃ dhāretun ti. ||3||23||
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sikkāya pattaṃ uṭṭitvā daṇḍe ālaggetvā vikāle aññatarena gāmadvārena atikkamati.
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.3: es' ayyo coro gacchati asi 'ssa vijjotalatīti anupatitvā gahetvā sañjānitvā muñciṃsu.
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.4: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etaṃ atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.5: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso daṇḍasikkaṃ dhāresīti.
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.8: kathañ hi nāma bhikkhu daṇḍasikkaṃ dhāressatīti.
pli-tv-kd15:24.1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --la--.
pli-tv-kd15:24.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti, na sakkoti vinā daṇḍena āhiṇḍituṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:24.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa bhikkhuno daṇḍasammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:24.2.5: tena gilānena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd15:24.2.13: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu gilāno na sakkoti vinā daṇḍena āhiṇḍituṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:24.2.15: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno daṇḍasammutiṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-kd15:24.2.21: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno daṇḍasammutiyā dānaṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd15:24.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti na sakkoti vinā sikkāya pattaṃ pariharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:24.3.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa bhikkhuno sikkāsammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:24.3.5: tena gilānena . . . (=. Instead of vinā daṇḍena āhiṇḍituṃ, etc.,
pli-tv-kd15:24.3.25: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti na sakkoti vinā daṇḍena āhiṇḍituṃ na sakkoti vinā sikkāya pattaṃ pariharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:24.3.27: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānassa bhikkhuno daṇḍasikkāsammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:24.3.32: na sakkomi vinā sikkāya pattaṃ pariharituṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:25.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu romanthako hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:25.1.6: eso bhikkhave bhikkhu aciraṃ goyoniyā cuto.
pli-tv-kd15:25.1.8: na ca bhikkhave bahi mukhadvārā nīharitvā ajjhoharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:26.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghabhattaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:26.1.4: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā odane diyyamāne na sakkaccaṃ paṭiggahessanti, ekamekaṃ sitthaṃ kammasatena niṭṭhāyatīti.
pli-tv-kd15:26.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:26.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:26.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ diyyamānaṃ patati taṃ sāmaṃ gahetvā paribhuñjituṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu dīghehi nakhehi piṇḍāya carati.
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.2: aññatarā itthi passitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.5: sace kho tvaṃ bhante na paṭisevissasi idān' āhaṃ attano nakhehi gattāni vilikhitvā kuppaṃ karissāmi
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.8: atha kho sā itthi attano nakhehi gattāni vilikhitvā kuppaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.11: addasāsuṃ kho te manussā tassā itthiyā nakhe chavim pi lohitam pi,
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.13: imissā yeva itthiyā idaṃ kammaṃ akārako bhikkhū 'ti
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.15: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.16: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso dīghe nakhe dhāresīti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.19: kathañ hi nāma bhikkhu dīghe nakhe dhāressatīti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:27.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū nakhena pi nakhaṃ chindanti mukhena pi nakhaṃ chindanti kuḍḍe pi nighaṃsanti,
pli-tv-kd15:27.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave maṃsappamāṇena nakhaṃ chinditun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.2.8: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vīsatimaṭṭaṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhūnaṃ kesā dīghā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.3.3: ussahanti pana bhikkhave bhikkhū aññamaññaṃ kese oropetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.3.5: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā
pli-tv-kd15:27.3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave khuraṃ khurasilaṃ khurasipāṭikaṃ namatakaṃ sabbaṃ khurabhaṇḍan ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd15:27.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū massuṃ kappāpenti
pli-tv-kd15:27.4.21: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno sambādhe vaṇo hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:27.4.24: anujānāmi bhikkhave ābādhapaccayā sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpetun ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kattarikāya kese chedāpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno sīse vaṇo hoti, na sakkoti khurena kese oropetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave ābādhapaccayā kattarikāya kese chedāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.10: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dīghāni nāsikālomāni dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.16: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sakkharikāya pi madhusitthakena pi nāsikālomaṃ gāhāpenti,
pli-tv-kd15:27.5.20: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū palitaṃ gāhāpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.6.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno kaṇṇagūthakehi kaṇṇā thakitā honti.
pli-tv-kd15:27.6.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā kaṇṇamalaharaṇiyo dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:27.6.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimayan ti. ||6||27||
pli-tv-kd15:28.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bahuṃ lohabhaṇḍaṃ kaṃsabhaṇḍaṃ sannicayaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd15:28.1.2: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd15:28.1.3: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā bahuṃ lohabhaṇḍaṃ kaṃsabhaṇḍaṃ sannicayaṃ karissanti, seyyathāpi kaṃsapattharikā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:28.1.5: na bhikkhave lohabhaṇḍaṃ kaṃsabaṇḍhaṃ sannicayo kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:28.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū añjanim pi añjanisalākam pi kaṇṇamalaharaṇim pi bandhanamattam pi kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-kd15:28.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave añjaniṃ añjanisalākaṃ kaṇṇamalaharaṇiṃ bandhanamattan ti.
pli-tv-kd15:28.2.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃghāṭipallatthikāya nisīdanti,
pli-tv-kd15:28.2.9: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti,
pli-tv-kd15:28.2.10: tassa vinā āyogena na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:28.2.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave tantakaṃ vemakaṃ vaṭaṃ salākaṃ sabbaṃ tantabhaṇḍan ti. ||2||28||
pli-tv-kd15:29.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu akāyabandhano gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi,
pli-tv-kd15:29.1.5: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:29.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacāni kāyabandhanāni dhārenti
pli-tv-kd15:29.2.17: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvace vidhe dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Ānando lahukā saṃghāṭiyo pārupitvā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi,
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.3: atha kho āyasmā Ānando ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.6: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacā gaṇṭhikāyo dhārenti sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhimayaṃ dantamayaṃ visāṇamayaṃ naḷamayaṃ veḷumayaṃ kaṭṭhamayaṃ jatumayaṃ phalamayaṃ lohamayaṃ saṅkhanābhimayaṃ suttamayan ti.
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.13: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gaṇṭhikam pi pāsakam pi cīvare appenti,
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.17: gaṇṭhikaphalakam pi pāsakaphalakam pi ante appenti,
pli-tv-kd15:29.3.21: pāsakaphalakaṃ sattaṅgulaṃ vā aṭṭhaṅgulaṃ vā ogāhetvā appetun ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd15:29.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū gihinivatthaṃ nivāsenti
pli-tv-kd15:29.4.9: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū gihipārutaṃ pārupanti.
pli-tv-kd15:29.5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saṃvelliyaṃ nivāsenti.
pli-tv-kd15:30.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ubhatokājaṃ haranti.
pli-tv-kd15:30.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekatokājaṃ antarākājaṃ sīsabhāraṃ khandhabhāraṃ kaṭibhāraṃ olambakan ti. ||30||
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū dantakaṭṭhaṃ na khādanti,
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.4: pañc' ime bhikkhave ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane:
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.5: acakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonandhati, bhattam assa na cchādeti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.6: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.7: pañc' ime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane:
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.8: cakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonandhati, bhattam assa chādeti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.1.9: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane.
pli-tv-kd15:31.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dīghāni dantakaṭṭhāni khādanti, teh' eva sāmaṇeraṃ ākoṭenti.
pli-tv-kd15:31.2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgulaparamaṃ dantakaṭṭhaṃ. na ca tena sāmaṇero ākoṭetabbo.
pli-tv-kd15:31.2.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno atimaṭāhakaṃ dantakaṭṭhaṃ khādantassa kaṇṭhe vilaggaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dāyaṃ ālimpenti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.7: tena kho pana samayena vihārā tiṇagahaṇā honti, davaḍāhe ḍayhamāne vihārā ḍayhanti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.8: bhikkhū kukkuccāyanti paṭaggiṃ dātuṃ parittaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:32.1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave davaḍāhe ḍayhamāne paṭaggiṃ dātuṃ parittaṃ kātun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rukkhaṃ abhirūhanti rukkhā rukkhaṃ saṃkamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.7: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchantassa antarā magge hatthī pariyuṭṭhāti.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.8: atha kho so bhikkhu rukkhamūlaṃ upadhāvitvā kukkuccāyanto rukkhaṃ na abhirūhati,
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.10: atha kho so bhikkhu Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd15:32.2.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave sati karaṇīye porisiyaṃ rukkhaṃ abhirūhituṃ, āpadāsu yāvadatthan ti. ||2||32||
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Yameḷutekulā nāma bhikkhū dve bhātikā honti brāhmaṇajātikā kalyāṇavācā kalyāṇavākkaraṇā.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.2: te yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.4: etarahi bhante bhikkhū nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā,
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.6: handa mayaṃ bhante buddhavacanaṃ chandaso āropemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.8: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā evaṃ vakkhatha:
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.9: handa mayaṃ bhante buddhavacanaṃ chandaso āropemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.1.15: anujānāmi bhikkhave sakāya niruttiyā buddhavacanaṃ pariyāpuṇitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū lokāyataṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.6: api nu kho bhikkhave lokāyate sāradassāvī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.8: imasmiṃ vā pana dhammavinaye sāradassāvī lokāyataṃ pariyāpuṇeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.12: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū lokāyataṃ vācenti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.18: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.2.24: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tiracchānavijjaṃ vācenti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento khipi.
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.8: api nu kho bhikkhave khipite jīvā 'ti vutte tappaccayā jīveyya vā mareyya vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.12: tena kho pana samayena manussā bhikkhūnaṃ khipite jīvatha bhante 'ti vadanti,
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.15: kathañ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā jīvatha bhante 'ti vuccamānā nālapissantīti.
pli-tv-kd15:33.3.18: anujānāmi bhikkhave gihīnaṃ jīvatha bhante 'ti vuccamānena ciraṃ jīvā 'ti vattun ti. ||3||33||
pli-tv-kd15:34.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā mahatiyā parisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:34.1.6: addasā kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:34.1.8: kiṃ nu kho so bhikkhave bhikkhu ekamantaṃ nisinno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:34.1.13: api nu kho bhikkhave taṃ khāditabbaṃ yaṃ khāditvā evarūpāya dhammakathāya paribāhiro assā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd15:34.2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Sāriputtassa udaravātābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:34.2.2: atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd15:34.2.3: pubbe te āvuso Sāriputta udaravātābādho kena phāsu hotīti.
pli-tv-kd15:34.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave ābādhapaccayā lasunaṃ khāditun ti. ||2||34||
pli-tv-kd15:35.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ārāme tahaṃ-tahaṃ passāvaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd15:35.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekamantaṃ passāvaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ārāme tahaṃ-tahaṃ vaccaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd15:35.2.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave ekamantaṃ vaccaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.2.21: anujānāmi bhikkhave santharivā majjhe chiddaṃ katvā vaccaṃ kātun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.3.9: ajjhokāse vaccaṃ karontā sītena pi uṇhena pi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.3.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave kavāṭaṃ piṭṭhasaṃghāṭaṃ udukkhalikaṃ uttarapāsakaṃ aggaḷavaṭṭiṃ kapisīsakaṃ sūcikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ tālacchiddaṃ āviñchanacchiddaṃ āviñchanarajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.3.15: setavaṇṇaṃ kālavaṇṇaṃ gerukaparikammaṃ mālākammaṃ latākammaṃ makaradantakaṃ pañcapaṭṭhikaṃ cīvaravaṃsaṃ cīvarajjun ti.
pli-tv-kd15:35.3.16: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu jarādubbalo vaccaṃ katvā vuṭṭhahanto paripati.
pli-tv-kd15:35.4.20: ācamanapādukā pākaṭā honti, bhikkhū hirīyanti ācametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd15:35.4.23: ācamanakumbhī apārutā hoti, tiṇacuṇṇehi pi paṃsukehi pi okirīyati.
pli-tv-kd15:36.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācaranti:
pli-tv-kd15:37.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmante Uruvelakassape pabbajite saṃghassa bahuṃ lohabhaṇḍaṃ dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd15:37.1.3: kiṃ nu kho bhagavatā lohabhaṇḍaṃ anuññātaṃ kiṃ ananuññātaṃ,
pli-tv-kd15:37.1.5: kiṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ anuññātaṃ kiṃ ananuññātan ti.
pli-tv-kd15:37.1.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd15:37.1.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā paharaṇiṃ sabbaṃ lohabhaṇḍaṃ, ṭhapetvā āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ dārupattaṃ dārupādukaṃ sabbaṃ dārubhaṇḍaṃ, ṭhapetvā katakañ ca kumbhakārikañ cā sabbaṃ mattikābhaṇḍan ti. ||37|| khuddakavatthukkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ
